paper_title: A Controllable Examination for Long-Context Language Models
caption: The bar chart of performance by different attributes on the 2-retrieval task. For simplicity, we abbreviate the names of all instruct models.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different attributes on a multi-retrieval task (n=2), comparing the performance of four models—Qwen2.5-7b-1M, InternLM3-8b, ProLong-8b, and Qwen2.5-7b—across four attributes: city, hobby, university, and major, with birthdate included as a separate category. The horizontal axis lists the models, while the vertical axis represents accuracy on a scale from 0 to 100. Each model's performance is shown as a group of four bars, with colors corresponding to the attributes: city (teal), hobby (orange), university (blue), and major (purple), with birthdate (green) represented as a separate bar for each model. For Qwen2.5-7b-1M, all attribute bars are high, with city and hobby around 90, university at 85, and major at 95. InternLM3-8b shows high accuracy in city (75), hobby (78), and major (65), with university at 60. ProLong-8b has high city (70), hobby (80), and birthdate (85) accuracy, but lower university (60) and major (30). Qwen2.5-7b has low accuracy across all attributes, with city and hobby around 5, university at 5, major at 10, and birthdate at 20. The bars are grouped by model, with each group showing the performance across the four attributes and birthdate. The chart shows that Qwen2.5-7b-1M performs best overall, followed by InternLM3-8b and ProLong-8b, with Qwen2.5-7b performing significantly worse.
